node: Student loan servicing and education payments
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the student-loan-servicing and education-payments node. The strongest direct exposures found are Nelnet for federal/private loan servicing plus education payments, Flywire for university and cross-border education payments, Maximus via Aidvantage federal student-loan servicing, and SLM/Sallie Mae as a private education-loan originator and servicer. This pass intentionally avoids megacap fintech/payment processors except as future context because the chokepoint hypothesis is more likely to be visible in niche education-finance and regulated servicing names.
